note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (single-party VU government, strong princely house), not measured data. Liechtenstein has no army; the military and security-services groups are given minimal weight. Influence reflects a financial-services and industrial economy, the Catholic Church as state church, and a small, closely connected political class.

interest_groups.note: No armed forces since 1868; the Landespolizei handles security.
The Catholic Church is the state church.
Foreign residents form a large share of the population.
